relations.label: 'dul TIka 'thad ldan (4682) has as an instance mdo' rtsa ba'i rnam bshad (8092)

comments:
Incomplete manuscript containing the first portion of the work (ending at the passage located on 181a3 in (ID:4681)).
Fols. 1-86 cover the section "dge slong gi rnam par 'byed pa gtan la dbab pa" (corresponding to 1-100a7 in (ID:4681)).
Starting on a new folio, but with continuous numbering 87, the text has a section starting with "thun mong ma yin pa' dge slong ma'i rnam par 'byed pa la gnyis las", which is absent in (ID:4681).
From. to fol. 182a, the text corresponds to fol. - 135b1 in (ID:4681).

An annotation on top of fol. 87a reports the view of "mnga ris pa." Annotations also identify some "kha cig" as "rgya" (probably rGya 'dul 'dzin dBang phyug tshul khrims (ID:3941)) and "sog" (likely Sog tshul khrims bla ma (ID:3940), Bya 'dul 'dzin's teacher). Also frequent are annotations "rma" and "cha" (the latter often below 'ti ka byed pa').
alternative_names: mdo' rtsa ba'i rnam bshad bya 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po shag kya'i dge slong brtson 'grus 'bar gyis mdzad pa (cover page)
name: mdo' rtsa ba'i rnam bshad
item_description:
Folio numbering in both margins, in letters on the left, in cypher on the right (only up to 18).
Missing folio: 100 (or numbering mistake?).
Annotations by several hands.
Beginning and end of sections written in red ink, and portions of text highlighted in color.
